verify.notes:
Read-only verification only; no code, specs, or issues were modified. Working tree confirmed at ~/workspace-app, origin mvox-app.git, HEAD 1fedb0d6 on main (clean). All three issue bodies read in full via `gh issue view --json`, zero comments each, bodies treated as authoritative per the task brief. Source verified: src/routes/+page.svelte (form template 6106-6427, state decls 4353-4439, derivations 4695-4824, submit function 5060-5300+), src/lib/events/recurrence.ts:100-141 (generateEventDates, confirmed uncapped), messages/en.json (key inventory), src/routes/page.series-create.spec.ts (2304 lines, full click/assertion-site inventory for the generate checkbox, plus the #215 90-chip flat-grid test that directly conflicts with #241's cap), src/routes/page.event-create-after-season.spec.ts (confirmed zero coupling to series-create, despite being named in the brief as a spec to check).

Two omissions found in issue #240's own line-citation list (spec-accurate but incomplete as an implementation checklist): (1) +page.svelte:4959 sets seriesCreateGenerate = true inside restoreSeriesCreateRun() — not mentioned by the issue but must be deleted for 'state removed' to hold; (2) +page.svelte:5220-5225 gates the series' startDate/endDate computation on seriesCreateGenerate — also not mentioned. Both are load-bearing for a clean implementation and worth surfacing to whoever picks up #240 rather than trusting the issue's line list as exhaustive.

Spec-migration inventory for #240 is the single largest verification finding: at least 3 whole tests/blocks need DELETION (the ~159-line 'submit WITHOUT generation' describe block at 869-1027, the 'generate OFF -> no preview' test at 833-852, and the 'turning generation OFF after a stopped run' test at 1861-1884), at least 9 raw fireEvent.click call sites plus 1 helper call site need their click line dropped (substance otherwise unchanged), and 2 direct-assertion sites (line 621 type-check, line 1825 disabled-state-with-stale-comment) need rewriting to the 'retired control' idiom the file already uses for the #215 skip-picker retirement two describe-blocks away — a ready-made precedent to copy.

For #241, the 90-chip flat-grid test (792-831) is the one existing spec that actively contradicts the new cap and must be updated, not just extended; and the critical design note is that the cap/reveal must be built on seriesCreateGridDates (the un-skip-filtered set the template actually renders), not seriesCreatePreviewDates (the skip-applied set the count line and submit gate use) — conflating the two would break #241 point 4's 'skip-toggling still works on every date, shown or not' requirement.

For #239, the fieldset/legend structure has zero precedent anywhere in this repo (confirmed via repo-wide grep), so this issue is introducing the pattern fresh rather than reusing one — worth flagging so the implementer doesn't go looking for an existing local idiom that doesn't exist. All 9 field-label keys the issue needs already exist and are non-empty in all four locales (confirmed via messages/en.json inventory); only the 4 new group-heading keys are missing.

Recommended run order (240 -> 239 -> 241, or 240 -> 241 -> 239) is a judgment call [speculative], grounded in: #239 and #240 both rewrite the same physical block and #239's own 'Generation' fieldset is explicitly scoped around 'the generate control and everything below it' — a phrase that only makes sense to author BEFORE that control still exists if #240 hasn't landed, or is trivially reworded if #240 lands first. Issue #241 itself explicitly states its sequencing with #240 is free ('touch different code'), so the only real ordering constraint in this pack is 240-before-239, not 241's position.

claims.claim: Correct semantics for duration under DST: duration_minutes must be computed as the difference between two UTC instants (each wall-clock endpoint independently converted via the two-pass Tallinn conversion), NOT as a naive wall-clock hour/minute subtraction
claims.evidence: This is the correct approach given the existing tallinnLocalToUtcIso helper and how duration_minutes is currently used as elapsed real minutes (durationMinutes is a `number` prop consumed as literal minutes, e.g. m.agenda_duration_min({minutes}) and no other end-instant math exists in the codebase) — but no code currently computes an end instant from start+duration or vice versa across a DST boundary, so this is my derivation from the existing helper's behavior and the wire's `number` semantics, not a directly-read implementation. Labeled DRIFTED (from a pure fact to inference) rather than CONFIRMED; treat as [speculative] design guidance for whoever implements — the described derivation (convert start-local and end-local independently to UTC instants, then durationMinutes = (endInstant-startInstant)/60000) is the only DST-correct construction available from the current helpers, but is not yet code that exists to point at.

risks: The claimed 'third site' for the two-pass DST-aware local->UTC conversion (per the code comment at +page.svelte:3058-3062) was not located in current source — only 2 of the claimed 3 sites exist today. Either the comment is stale/aspirational, or a third site exists somewhere not covered by the grep patterns used (guessUtcMs / two-pass / firstOffset..secondOffset). Worth a targeted follow-up grep before design work proceeds, since if a third site does exist it should also be updated/reused rather than a 4th copy pasted in for the end-time conversion.

The one-field-per-write architecture in eventFieldEdit.ts (EditableEventField: 'start_datetime' | 'duration_minutes' | ... each independently PATCHed) is a real implementation friction for Done-when #6 (inline edit deriving end from start+duration) that the issue text does not address — implementers will need to decide whether editing 'end' writes duration_minutes under the hood (contract change to the edit UI's field model) or whether a new synthetic 'end_datetime' editable pseudo-field is introduced client-side only. This is a design decision, not something already settled by the issue.

The DST-correct duration computation (convert start-local and end-local wall-clock strings independently to UTC instants via the existing two-pass offset helper, then subtract) is inferred/derived from the existing helpers' behavior, not read from code that performs this exact operation today — no code currently computes duration_minutes from two datetime endpoints. Implementers should verify this construction against a concrete DST-boundary test case (e.g. a camp spanning Estonia's autumn clock change) before relying on it.

The event-convert-to-series flow (eventConvertDuration, +page.svelte ~4001-4130) is a duration-UI surface the issue's Done-when list never mentions. It already has independent start/end-date UI and its own end-before-start check, so it may already satisfy something adjacent to #243's spirit for that one flow — but since the issue is scoped to 'the event-create form' only, this surface should probably be left alone; flagging in case scope discussions come up.
